name: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners
exchange: Nasdaq (also listed on Euronext Amsterdam, per the 20-F cover)

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (LOGO).png; Commons file, 300+ px)

description: CCEP is the bottler, not the brand owner. It makes, sells and distributes Coca-Cola, Fanta, Sprite, Monster and other brand owners' drinks to shops, cafes and vending in Western Europe, Australia, the Pacific, Indonesia and (since 2024) the Philippines, under bottling agreements with The Coca-Cola Company (TCCC). About 88 percent of revenue comes from TCCC-agreement products. It earns the margin between the concentrate it buys and what it gets selling finished drinks, so it carries the factories, trucks and salesforce that the brand owner does not. Revenue was EUR 20.9 billion in 2025; Europe is 74 percent of it.

hq.note: Pemberton House, Bakers Road, Uxbridge, UB8 1EZ; public company limited by shares, incorporated under the laws of England and Wales (FY2025 20-F)

employees.note: 'Our 39,000 colleagues' (FY2025 20-F); as-of date assumed year end

businessLines.name: Europe
businessLines.how: Buys concentrate from TCCC and other brand owners, bottles and cans the drinks and sells them to retailers and out-of-home customers; revenue per unit case rises with price and mix; hit in 2025 by higher sugar taxes in France and GB and consumer focus on affordability.
businessLines.description: Western Europe, including Great Britain, Germany, Iberia, France, the Netherlands and Sweden (markets named in the 20-F).

businessLines.name: Asia Pacific (APS)
businessLines.how: Same bottler model in emerging markets; 2024 growth came from the jointly acquired Philippines business, now renamed Coca-Cola Europacific Aboitiz Philippines.
businessLines.description: Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific, Indonesia, and the Philippines (acquired 2024-02-23).

brands.note: Brand owner Monster Energy Corporation; CCEP calls it a key growth partner in energy

brands.name: Coca-Cola Europacific Aboitiz Philippines, Inc. (formerly Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines); acquired 100% jointly with Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc. from TCCC on 2024-02-23
